task: V2 4-direction visual comparison for mindtap notes app
v1_skip_reason: User explicitly said: '不用做 V1 4×4 那一轮了，直接 V2 4 方向全屏对比'. Honored the request — V1 4×4 glass-density matrix not produced.

A.name: macOS 26 Tahoe · Liquid Glass
key_signals: traffic lights, glass 'compose' button, scroll-edge mask

B.name: Editorial · Reading-first
B.rationale: Opposite pole from D on the density axis. Single column, wide measure, serif body, minimal chrome — for users who treat notes as long-form prose.

C.name: Paper Zine · Tactile / Hand
C.rationale: Emotional counterweight to A. Warm handcrafted feel — polaroids, tape, sticky notes, doodles, hand-circled checklist — for users who want a personal scrapbook vibe.
key_signals: tape stickers, pin, polaroid, sticky notes

D.name: Engineering Doc · Dark · Mono · Dense
key_signals: JetBrains Mono / Fira Code mono everywhere
4-row IDE grid: titlebar / tabs / 3-col main / status
file tree, line gutter, code block with syntax colors

axis_map.density: D (densest) ↔ B (sparsest); A and C in middle
axis_map.warmth: A / D cold ↔ B / C warm
axis_map.mood: A = professional · D = geek · B = literary · C = personal

content_consistency: All 4 prototypes share the same sample note '色彩与光线' (June 14, 2026) so the user can compare presentation choices on identical source content.
notes: HTML files are self-contained, no external assets, no JS. All layouts work at 1280×800 with realistic density. Index page (v2-index.html) provides 2×2 grid with mini CSS previews of each style and links to the full pages.
